doc.brief: The QStackedLayout class provides a stack of widgets where only one widget is visible at a time.
doc.index_brief: Stack of widgets where only one widget is visible at a time

QStackedLayout().brief: Constructs a QStackedLayout with no parent.

QStackedLayout(QLayout *parentLayout).brief: Constructs a new QStackedLayout and inserts it into the given *parentLayout*.

QStackedLayout(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a new QStackedLayout with the given *parent*.

QStackedLayout::StackingMode stackingMod.brief: determines the way visibility of child widgets are handled.

QWidget * currentWidget() const.brief: Returns the current widget, or `nullptr` if there are no widgets in this layout.

QWidget * widget(int index) const.brief: Returns the widget at the given *index*, or `nullptr` if there is no widget at the given position.

int addWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Adds the given *widget* to the end of this layout and returns the index position of the *widget*.

int count() const override.brief: This property holds the number of widgets contained in the layout

int currentIndex() const.brief: This property holds the index position of the widget that is visible

int insertWidget(int index, QWidget *wid.brief: Inserts the given *widget* at the given *index* in this [QStackedLayout](xref:qt:QStackedLayout).

void currentChanged(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the current widget in the layout changes.

void setCurrentIndex(int index).brief: This property holds the index position of the widget that is visible

void setCurrentWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Sets the current widget to be the specified *widget*.

void setStackingMode(QStackedLayout::Sta.brief: determines the way visibility of child widgets are handled.

void widgetAdded(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a widget is added or inserted.

void widgetRemoved(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a widget is removed from the layout.

count.brief: The number of widgets contained in the layout

currentIndex.brief: The index position of the widget that is visible

stackingMode.brief: Determines the way visibility of child widgets are handled
